assays.assay_description: Head twitches were recorded for 20 min immediately after i.p. injection of psilocybin (4.4 mg/kg) or 5-HTP (200 mg/kg), with or without prior administration of 5-HT receptor modulators (8-OH-DPAT, M100907, RS-102221), using a magnetometer apparatus. HTR data were obtained from the same mice used in Shahar et al., 2022 and correlated with IEG expression measured 1 h post-injection.

application_type.evidence: Drugs were administered by i.p. injection in a standard injection volume of 300 µL immediately before HTR was performed.

setup_habituation.evidence: Paper does not describe habituation to the magnetometer apparatus prior to recording.

setup_restrain.evidence: HTR was measured... by means of a magnetometer apparatus (free-moving mice; no restraint described).

food_restriction.evidence: Animals were housed... with free access to food and water; HTR recording occurred in the magnetometer apparatus where food was not accessible.

water_restriction.evidence: Animals were housed... with free access to food and water; water was not present in the magnetometer apparatus during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: HTR was measured... for 20 min immediately after injection of the drug at ZT4 (11 a.m.)

sample_size.evidence: Comparisons were made between groups of 8-10 mice in each of the treatment groups.

outcomes.summary: PSIL (4.4 mg/kg, i.p.) induced a robust head-twitch response over the 20-min recording, whereas 5-HTP also induced HTR (as reported in Shahar et al., 2022). No significant correlation was observed between PSIL-induced total or peak HTR and IEG (cfos, egr1, egr2) expression in somatosensory cortex.
outcomes.evidence: No correlation was observed between the head twitch response (HTR) induced by PSIL and its effect on the IEGs.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Pearson correlations between cfos, egr1 and egr2 levels induced by PSIL and total... and peak HTR

judge_notes: Only one behavioural assay (Head Twitch Response) is scored. All other measurements (IEG mRNA expression via qRT-PCR, RNA extraction) are molecular endpoints and excluded per rubric.
HTR data were collected on mice from a prior study (Shahar et al., 2022) and re-analysed here for correlation with IEG expression; treated as one assay.
B1 scored 1 (2-3 measures): total HTR and peak HTR are both reported as separate variables correlated with IEGs.
Dosing reconciled across candidates: PSIL, PME, and 5-HTP all administered; only PSIL HTR data used in this paper's correlation analysis.
